counter_arguments_tested: (a) Methodology flaw: Rahu/Ketu may be excluded from the gochara engine entirely, so their absence from the marriage window would not be evidence of 5th/9th aspect TRUNCATION specifically.
(b) The audit's own astrology may be wrong - Ketu@Leo may not actually aspect natal Venus, Rahu@Aquarius may not actually aspect the 7th.
(c) Doctrinal: nodal 5/9 aspects are later-tradition, not BPHS. primitives.py cites BPHS Ch.26 as its authority, so 7th-only may be a defensible deliberate doctrinal choice rather than a defect.

test_a_result.conclusion: Nodes DO participate in drishti_contact - 172 terms on this chart. They are truncated, not excluded. Counter-argument (a) FAILS and the truncation mechanism is confirmed.

test_b_result.ketu_5th_from_Leo: Sagittarius == natal Venus sign  -> aspect lands on natal Venus CONFIRMED
test_b_result.rahu_9th_from_Aquarius: Libra == 7th house sign -> aspect lands on the natal 7th CONFIRMED
test_b_result.conclusion: Counter-argument (b) FAILS. Both angular claims verify exactly.

test_c_result.primitives_py_read: SPECIAL_DRISHTI_DEG = {Mars:[90,180,210], Jupiter:[120,180,240], Saturn:[60,180,270]}; _DEFAULT_DRISHTI_DEG=[180.0]; comment cites BPHS Ch.26. No Rahu/Ketu entry.
test_c_result.w30_nodal_drishti_docstring: Explicitly states the 5/7/9 nodal rule is attested only in LATER tradition (Phaladeepika c.16th c., Saravali, later Parashari sub-commentaries) and is NOT in original BPHS.
test_c_result.conclusion: Counter-argument (c) HAS REAL DOCTRINAL FORCE and the finding does not carry the nuance - but it does NOT overturn the finding, on three grounds: (1) this same codebase already grants nodal 5/9 on another live surface (ga_structural_writer.py NODE_PARASHARI_ASPECTS={5,7,9}, served via ganita_structural_get), so the four aspect tables are internally inconsistent under ANY doctrine; (2) R24 is a binding project ruling mandating nodal 5/7/9 full-strength, not the auditor preference; (3) w30_nodal_drishti exists in engine.py as the intended compensator and leaves no trace in served window data (F-21).

outcome: SURVIVES REFUTATION, with a doctrinal-provenance refinement recommended for the finding text.
